name: GoalLore Lab: premium motion style (DESIGN, not yet used in production)
concept: A floodlit pitch at night seen from the tactics camera, with chalk-board clarity. Players are clean tokens (never likeness), the ball leaves a real trajectory, and the story is told on the pitch itself. Archival scenes use newsprint paper; numbers come only from cited records.
distinctFrom: The Hidden Logic of Things (warm desk, printed matter) and Failure Reconstructed (cold blueprint): GoalLore Lab is night-green, chalk-white and floodlight-gold.
rules: Players are numbered tokens or silhouettes, never a person's likeness; no club crests.
Positions and runs in reconstructions are labelled RECONSTRUCTION unless they come from published tracking data that is cited.
What-if scenes carry the WHAT IF chip for their whole duration.
Every number on screen comes from a cited record.
